deviations_from_card: (1) The warning's button reads 'Open Main', not 'Open Accounts': athenaOpenMain only raises Main and cannot select the Accounts depth (that needs a cross-window command in console files outside the write set). The ADR says so. (2) connectorLineOf takes an optional 5th arg, the card's action. The writes-off warning reads switchGoverns, a mirror of service.is_write (reversible is False or external), so it never predicts a refusal the daemon would not make. isWrite (the Accounts 'writes, gated' list) defers to gate.js classify as the card asked. (3) A not-connected record is also a warning cause ('Gmail is not connected'); a connector absent from a loaded list reads as unconfirmed. (4) The mirror reads once per arriving connector card id, not once per window, so a grant that lapsed between two cards is re-read. (5) Case 2's acceptance wording got a closing period: '..., so approving now will be refused.' (6) modules/connectors/fixtures.ts and stores/connectors in Main were not changed beyond the store; views.test.tsx (a test file outside write_set) gained the two view tests.
notes: Guard 7 is split in two. The model half (a host card is unchanged by the mirror) was green before, by design. The view half (a warning never disables Approve) needs a connector line, so it was red before; it is counted in cases_red_before=7. Premise drift the coordinator should know: the card's 'the Accounts row lists every tool the writes switch actually governs' is not quite true. The daemon's writes switch (src/athena/connectors/service.py is_write) uses reversible is False, not default_class. So a tool that omits reversible is now listed under writes (gated, matching the catalog) but is still not stopped by the writes switch. No built-in spec omits reversible. Aligning service.is_write with default_class is a daemon follow-up (it tightens). Earlier waves' changes re-verified: ConnectionRecord attempt/notice shape untouched; rowOf's shape is unchanged (only isWrite changed), which keeps it safe for connector-service/B. No sibling reds. Took and released the shared lock for the ADR and CHANGELOG commit. Not verified in the real Tauri window.
